macros.name: AddSubtitlePublished
macros.doc: Adds \published and \subtitle, and related.

macros.name: affiliation
macros.doc: Adds the affiliation to the author for use in \maketitle.

macros.name: AltTextClose
macros.doc: HTML alt text is enclosed by the macros \AltTextOpen and \AltTextClose, which default to an opening and closing parenthesis.

macros.name: CaptionSeparator
macros.doc: How to separate the float number and the caption text, if not defined by the user.

macros.name: CSSFilename
macros.doc: The name of the CSS file to use.

macros.name: displaymathnormal
macros.doc: By default, or when selecting \displaymathnormal, MATHJAX math display environments print their contents as text into HTML for MATHJAX to interpret, and SVG display math environments render their contents as SVG images and use their contents as the alt tag of HTML output.

macros.name: FilenameLimit
macros.doc: The maximum length of the filenames generated by lwarp.

macros.name: ForceHTMLTOC
macros.doc: To automatically force the HTML version of the document to have a TOC entry for a starred section, use \ForceHTMLTOC just before the \chapter* or \section*, and place \phantomsection and \addcontentsline inside a warpprint environment.

macros.name: HTMLAddMeta
macros.doc: Adds to the custom meta tags for the following pages.

macros.name: HTMLDescription
macros.doc: Sets the HTML description tag for the following files.

macros.name: HTMLFirstPageBottom
macros.doc: A user-definable custom action applied to the bottom of the home page.

macros.name: HTMLFirstPageTop
macros.doc: A user-definable custom action applied to the top of the home page.

macros.name: HTMLKeywords
macros.doc: Sets the HTML keywords tag for the following files.

macros.name: HTMLLanguage
macros.doc: The language to declare for each web page.

macros.name: HTMLleftmargini
macros.doc: Sets \leftmargini inside a verse environment in HTML.

macros.name: HTMLMeta
macros.doc: Clears then sets a new user-definable custom meta tag used for the following pages.

macros.name: HTMLnewcolumntype
macros.doc: Provides simplified replacement text for HTML.

macros.name: HTMLPageBottom
macros.doc: A user-definable custom action applied to the bottom of pages other than the home page.

macros.name: HTMLPageTop
macros.doc: A user-definable custom action applied to the top of pages other than the home page.

macros.name: HTMLTitle
macros.doc: Overrides \title for the HTML header’s meta title.

macros.name: HTMLTitleAfterSection
macros.doc: Sets subpage <title> tags to show the section name followed by the website title.

macros.name: HTMLTitleBeforeSection
macros.doc: Sets subpage <title> tags to show the website title followed by the section name.

macros.name: HTMLvleftskip
macros.doc: Sets \vleftskip inside a verse environment in HTML.

macros.name: IgnoreMinipageWidths
macros.doc: Locally requests that minipage widths be ignored.

macros.name: ImageAltText
macros.doc: The default HTML alt text for \includegraphics and lateximages.

macros.name: IndexPageSeparator
macros.doc: User-adjustable delimiters for page and range separators in the *.ind files.

macros.name: LateximageFontScale
macros.doc: Declares how large to scale inline SVG math images.

macros.name: LateximageFontSizeName
macros.doc: Declares how large to write text in \lateximages.

macros.name: LinkHome
macros.doc: Creates a link to the home page.

macros.name: linkhomename
macros.doc: Holds the default name for the home link.

macros.name: LinkNext
macros.doc: Creates a link to the next HTML page, unless already at the end.

macros.name: linknextname
macros.doc: What to call the link to the next web page.

macros.name: LinkPrevious
macros.doc: Creates a link to the previous HTML page, unless already at the home page.

macros.name: linkpreviousname
macros.doc: What to call the link to the previous web page.

macros.name: LWRopquote
macros.doc: The operating system’s quote mark, UNIX default.

macros.name: LWRopseq
macros.doc: The operating system’s sequential execution command, UNIX default.

macros.name: MathImageAltText
macros.doc: For SVG math images, the alt tag under some conditions will be set to \MathImageAltText, which defaults to math image.

macros.name: MathJaxFilename
macros.doc: Sets the MATHJAX script file to use for the following files.

macros.name: PackageDiagramAltText
macros.doc: For packages, the alt tag is set using the package name followed by \PackageDiagramAltText, which defaults to diagram.

macros.name: printthanks
macros.doc: Forces the \thanks to be printed.

macros.name: SetHTMLFileNumber
macros.doc: Sets the file number for the next file to be generated.

macros.name: sidetocname
macros.doc: Displayed at the head of the sideTOC.

macros.name: ThisAltText
macros.doc: \ThisAltText can be used to assign an HTML alt text attribute to the next image generated by a lateximage, picture, tikzpicture, or any other similar environment which generates an image, or the next SVG math expression.

macros.name: tracinglwarp
macros.doc: Turns on the debug tracing messages.

macros.name: UseMinipageWidths
macros.doc: Locally requests that minipage widths be honored.

macros.name: warpHTMLonly
macros.doc: Performs the given actions only when HTML output is being generated.

macros.name: warpprintonly
macros.doc: Performs the given actions only when print output is being generated.

envs.name: fminipage
envs.doc: To create a framed minipage in both print and HTML: A new environment fminipage is included. For print output, this is identical to minipage, except that it is also framed.

envs.name: warpall
envs.doc: Anything which is to be done for any output may be surrounded by a warpall environment.

envs.name: warpHTML
envs.doc: An environment which is only included while generating HTML output.

envs.name: warpMathJax
envs.doc: Anything which is to be done only while using HTML output with MATHJAX is surrounded by a warpMathJax environment.

envs.name: warpprint
envs.doc: An environment which is only used while generating print output.

envs.name: warpsvg
envs.doc: SVG math is surrounded by a warpsvg environment.
